name: Review Highlights / Themes
summary: Wrapping collection of target-supplied review themes and optional counts without fixed filtering semantics.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Responsive collection boundary for target-supplied review themes.

anatomy.name: tag
anatomy.description: Repeated theme item; its native element and interaction semantics are chosen by the target.

anatomy.name: count
anatomy.description: Optional target-formatted count associated with one theme item.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional accessible name for the themes region when surrounding context does not already name it.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Target-owned repeated theme items and counts; selection mode and result synchronization are not implied.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Touch-sized theme items with contained long labels.

states.name: default
states.description: Theme collection with target-owned item semantics.

states.name: itemHover
states.description: Fine-pointer feedback for an available native theme action.

states.name: itemFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on an interactive theme item.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Toggle-button selection hook when a target chooses in-place selection.

states.name: activeClass
states.description: Presentation hook for a target-owned active item; it does not define semantics by itself.

behavior.name: itemSemanticsBoundary
behavior.description: Targets choose passive text, native navigation, or in-place selection. The neutral component does not define filtering, single versus multiple selection, URLs, or result announcements.

behavior.name: countOwnership
behavior.description: Counts are supplied and synchronized by the target data source rather than calculated by this component.

accessibility: Use native buttons for in-place selection and expose current toggle state with aria-pressed.
Use native links for navigation and an appropriate current-page attribute when applicable.
Do not apply interactive semantics or a pointer cursor to passive theme text.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate a target-owned active state.
Keep each count programmatically associated with its theme label.

web.notes: Wrapping, touch, focus, disabled, forced-color, and reduced-motion presentation is implemented; item effects remain target-owned.

shopify.notes: A future adapter must define theme data and item semantics before adding filtering behavior.
